Experience the timeless artistry of Ustad Vilayat Khan in "Sitar Ki Shaan," a mesmerizing jukebox featuring some of his most iconic performances. Renowned for his exceptional skill and profound understanding of the sitar, Ustad Vilayat Khan has left an indelible mark on Hindustani classical music.
